_doc: SutraVerse 2.0 character bible (rig: brand2/cast2.js). One entry per character. Never redraw a registered character by hand; add new characters here first and render their sheet with sheet2.py.

chanakya.role: Chanakya Files host: the strategist (c. 4th century BCE). Teacher, minister to Chandragupta Maurya. Lean, intense, shaved head with the untied shikha of his vow (tradition), ochre cloth, sacred thread.

riya.role: Office Shastra lead, 27, product analyst in Bengaluru. Sharp, fair-minded, gets talked over.

kabir.role: Office Shastra / Ghar Ki Baat, 29, backend engineer. People-pleaser learning to say no.

malhotra.role: Office Shastra boss, 52, VP. Charming in meetings, takes credit, plays favourites.

maa.role: Ghar Ki Baat mother, 54. Loves through food, never says it.

tanvi.role: Ghar Ki Baat / Mind Games: Kabir's younger sister, 26, UX designer in Pune. Warm, teasing, keeps the family group chat alive; hides hurt behind jokes.

papa.role: Ghar Ki Baat father, 58: Kabir and Tanvi's father, retired bank officer in Indore. Proud, stubborn, turns up the TV instead of talking; softens late.

rohan.role: Office Shastra / Chanakya Files: Rohan, 28, sales-turned-product candidate (and Malhotra's favourite in the Ekalavya Reel). Smooth talker, big smile, gelled hair, confident in every room; his work rarely matches the pitch.

sana.role: Chanakya Files / Office Shastra: Sana, 26, product-analyst candidate from Lucknow. Quiet, precise, speaks slowly in interviews; her take-home task is the one that actually works.

aarav.role: Ghar Ki Baat / Panchatantra Reloaded: Aarav, 15, Kabir and Tanvi's youngest brother, Class 10 in Indore. Doodles in the margins, switches off at lectures, lights up at a story.

dadi.role: Ghar Ki Baat / Turning Points: Dadi, 78, Kabir, Tanvi and Aarav's grandmother (Papa's mother), Indore. Keeps the family gold in a steel trunk, worries about 'log kya kahenge', sharp tongue, soft heart.

puppets._doc: Lamp Theatre (Panchatantra Reloaded) puppets: original jointed dyed-hide designs drawn by the Reel's shots.js puppet() helper (profile, rods, carved holes). Not CAST2 rig characters; same parameters every Reel.

vishnusharman.role: the old teacher of the Panchatantra frame story; open-cut face, white beard piece, staff

amarashakti.role: King Amarashakti of Mahilaropya; tall crown, solid face

prince.role: the three princes (same cut, three dyes); small crowns, slumped
